subject: Visibility add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing and next steps
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@pritech.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@pritech.com>, procurement@pritech.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Visibility add-ons — retention + tracing pricing?

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the dashboards looked great. We're starting to scope the visibility add-on (longer retention, distributed tracing sampling, and the advanced dashboard seats) for an initial rollout and I need concrete pricing to feed into our procurement cycle. A few details from our side:

- Current traffic: ~1M tokens/day (avg); peak bursts ~1.5M tokens/day
- Target retention: 90 days for full telemetry (logs/metrics/traces)
- Tracing: want distributed traces at 5% sampling for production traffic, with the option to spike to 20% during investigations
- Dashboards: 6 power users + 10 view-only seats
- Goal: 12-month procurement timeline, but want optionality if we need to scale mid-year

Can you send a line-item breakdown (monthly and annual), any available bundle discount for bundling retention+tracing+dashboard seats, and whether you can provide an introductory credit or short-term trial for retention beyond our existing allotment? Also call out any minimum commits required to get deeper discounts.

We need this for our internal vendor evaluation by Nov 27 — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Platform 
PriTech

[Attachment: PriTech_requirements_v1.docx (DOCX)]
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@pritech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — retention + tracing pricing?

Hi Maya — great to hear the demo clicked for your team. Thanks for the clear requirements — below is a concise set of options we can put on paper quickly. I attached a detailed pricing workbook (redwood_visibility_pricing_v2.xlsx) with unit math.

Summary (monthly list prices):
- Retention: 90-day tier: $1,200 / month per 1M tokens/day (includes storage + query ops); 30-day tier $500; 365-day tier $2,800
- Tracing: sample-rate model — base 1% free with product; 5% sampling: $600 / month per 1M tokens/day equivalent; spike-burst allowance: $0.02 per sampled-span above agreed cap
- Dashboards: Power seat $60 / seat / month; View-only $10 / seat / month

Visibility Plus bundle (recommended for your profile): 90-day retention + 5% tracing + 6 power seats + 10 view seats = list $2,480 / month (per 1M tokens/day). Workbook shows per-token scaling and burst ceilings.

Discounting and trials:
- 12-month annual committed purchase: 15% off add-on list prices (applies to bundle or line items)
- 24-month committed purchase: 22% off
- Short-term trial: we can offer 45 days of extended retention (to 90 days) as a trial credit for new add-on purchases (one-time) to validate ops workflows

Concessions we can explore (need internal approval):
- Up to an additional 5% commercial concession in exchange for reference case / logo + case study participation
- Onboarding credit ($8k) tied to a minimum 12-month commit

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30-min pricing workshop this week with your procurement to align on commit horizon and invoicing cadence
2) We'll drop a draft SOW + pricing spreadsheet (attached) and a DocuSign-ready SOW once terms are agreed

Ben — copying you in for commercial flexibility on the discount side. Lauren — can you prepare a short SOW template we can iterate on if PriTech wants the 12-month commit?

Maya — if that summary looks reasonable I'll convert the workbook figures into a clean SOW and a simple comparison table (monthly vs annual) and send it back by Monday.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0186

[Attachment: redwood_visibility_pricing_v2.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@pritech.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — retention + tracing pricing?

Maya — hi, Ben here (commercial). Appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Wanted to suggest a pragmatic path that helps PriTech get immediate value while fitting procurement constraints.

Counterproposal we can approve today (conditional on a 12-month add-on commit covering estimated usage):
- 20% off add-on list pricing for the first 12 months (bundle or line items)
- 60-day extended retention trial (applied as credit on first invoice)
- $6k onboarding credit for priority setup and dashboards workshop
- Tracing overage rate cap for first 6 months at 50% of list overage price (we absorb spike risk during ramp)

Conditions:
- Commit based on estimated 1M tokens/day baseline (true-up at quarter end)
- Signed SOW referencing RDW-2026-1187 and HubSpot record HS-987654

If that works for you, Aisha — let's prepare a DocuSign SOW and a short invoice schedule (monthly vs quarterly) and hand to procurement. I can authorize the 20% concession for this customer and will escalate if they ask for additional price cuts.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
